correctness.rationale: For open Johnson rank-two neighborhoods the positive fiber after a first pair e splits, under a second adjacent f, into a punctured star plus one exceptional pair; any further query leaves one child with at most two centers. Disjoint e,f leave exactly four hypotheses. Thus Ldim of each first-positive class is <=3 and the full class <=4. n=2 gives 0, n=3,4 gives 1 (for n=4 complementary center pairs have identical neighborhoods), and n=5,6 cannot reach 4 by hypothesis-count. The actual 8-leaf J(5,2) and 16-leaf J(7,2) certificates in lower_certificates.json realize depths 3 and 4 and embed into larger n. Independently recomputed exact adaptive recurrence for n=2..9 and checked finite certificate structure; it returned 0,1,1,3,3,4,4,4. Restriction to induced subgraphs only carries upper bound, not claimed exact Ldim.
